text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

Various presentations, introductions and announcements were made to City Council on November 13 and 14, 2024. November 13, 2024 Mayor Chow, during the morning session of the meeting, welcomed new Councillor Rachel Chernos Lin to the Council Chamber and congratulated Councillor Chernos Lin on her election. Speaker Nunziata, during the morning session of the meeting, called upon Mayor Chow to address City Council to recognize Jonathan Batty, Integrity Commissioner for the City of Toronto, on the end of his term. Mayor Chow welcomed Jonathan Batty’s spouse, Alison Drummond, and daughter, Lydia Batty, staff from the Integrity Commissioner’s office, and Toronto’s Accountability Officers, who were present in the Chamber.
